response.text: Article 15 of the GDPR gives a data subject the right to obtain from a controller confirmation whether their personal data are being processed and, if so, access to the personal data and specified information about the processing (e.g., purposes, categories of data, recipients, retention periods, and the existence of automated decision‑making). It also includes the right to receive a copy of the personal data undergoing processing (with the controller allowed to charge a reasonable fee for additional copies in some cases). ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1599219338705&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679&utm_source=openai))
